title: Question Big Causes for Big Events
description: When faced with a big event: - Ask yourself: "Is there solid evidence for a big cause, or am I assuming it because the event is large?" - Break it down: Look at smaller, logical factors that might explain the event. - Challenge conspiracy thinking: Focus on verified sources and avoid overgeneralizing. Example: A major market crash? Analyze economic trends rather than assuming a single catastrophic cause.
